limits: Only the two Novgorod-land contexts get names. Binding any other context or people needs a new approval covering its name rows; foreign peoples get their own pools (owner D51 p.2), never the Russian pool (LW-107).
About 160 approved entries are medieval_general (XI-XIV c.) and 32 candidate_compiled: dated plausibility, not individual 1230-1250 attestations.

Equal weights: the D46 catalog recommends lower weights for 12 male forms (Борислав, Путислав, Держимир, Дешевко, Местак, Местко, Пяток, Пятьша, Рюря, Салько, Тиша, Торчин) and 7 female forms (Сторонька, Милка, Страхота, Безубая, Втора, Неделька, Чудка); they are over-represented (about 6% of male and 11% of female picks) until B2 weights exist.

Spelling variants of one name are separate entries (Пелага/Пелагея/Пелагия; Гюрги/Гюргий/Гюргя/Гургий/Юрий/Георгий): a frequency skew, not an error. Different classes for variants follow the catalog §4.1.
«Яна» is a normalization of the attested «Янка» (letter 731), kept per catalog §17.3.
No Ольга, Елена, Василиса, Дарья, Матрёна, Прасковья: D46 typed gaps.

Goals and fears: confidence C; 60 rows basis=analogy; #195 additions marked sourced were not re-checked against primary sources; 15 occupations get no character (LW-109); 165 rows of 33 occupations absent from the actor registry stay inactive until those occupations exist (LW-111).
D29 scales are a game assumption with equal weights.
The loader does not check the pool validity period (LW-109).
Two NPCs in one scene may share a name (LW-108).
